name: Feathermoon Stronghold
summary: Sentinels watch southern Kalimdor from feathermoon stronghold, on sardor isle off Feralas. General Shandris Feathermoon commands the night elves along the Forgotten Coast.

sections.title: Sentinel Bastion of the South
sections.body: Across the channel from Feralas, feathermoon stronghold guards the Sentinels’ southern base on sardor isle. Ancient elven groves surround the fortress, and a sacred moonwell lies within its grounds. Archers, huntresses, and support staff serve under General Shandris Feathermoon. From the island, the night elves watch Feralas and guard against demonic corruption, dangerous wildlife, and Horde expeditions.

sections.title: A Safe Haven in the Wilds
sections.body:
Feralas’s mainland holds savage beasts, Gordunni ogres, and the tainted shadows of Dire Maul. Sardor Isle gives the stronghold a defensive buffer. Alliance travelers cross from the Forgotten Coast by ferry to its fortified docks, where they can repair their gear and gather intelligence.

General Shandris Feathermoon leads the Sentinels and is the trusted right hand of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Under her command, the stronghold holds against the enemies of the kaldorei.

aliases: how to get to feathermoon stronghold
faq.answer: Feathermoon Stronghold stands on Sardor Isle, off the Forgotten Coast at Feralas’s western edge. Travel west through the forest to the coast, then take the ferry across to the island fortress.

General Shandris Feathermoon commands Feathermoon Stronghold. She is supreme commander of the Sentinel army and the right hand of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. From the outpost, she oversees kaldorei military efforts throughout southern Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is the stronghold located on an island instead of the mainland?
aliases: why is feathermoon on an island
faq.answer: Sardor Isle gives Feathermoon Stronghold natural defenses against mainland Feralas’s dangers. Savage beasts, Gordunni ogres, and lingering arcane and demonic perils threaten the mainland. The island offers a secure port that controls coastal waters and keeps those threats at bay.

faq.q: Does Feathermoon Stronghold have a moonwell?
aliases: is there a moonwell at feathermoon
faq.answer: Yes, Feathermoon Stronghold has a sacred moonwell within its grounds. Far from their northern homeland, the night elf garrison finds spiritual focus, sustenance, and holy water there.

angles.text: For Alliance champions braving southern Kalimdor, Feathermoon Stronghold offers vital supplies, flight paths, and a headquarters amid Feralas’s hostile wilderness.
As a night elf, you can see the kaldorei’s resolve to safeguard Kalimdor in Feathermoon Stronghold. General Shandris Feathermoon leads this Sentinel encampment south of Ashenvale.
